guitar.notes: Reggae artist primarily vocalist; backing guitarists on his records not strongly documented individually.

tone.target: bright dry reggae/ska rhythm with springy clean chime
tone.profile: bright dry reggae/ska rhythm with springy clean chime
tone.summary: A pristine signal chain utilizing a Boost for initial clarity, followed by the US Deluxe amp model paired with the US 2x12 cab. Modulation is kept minimal (Chorus avoided) to maintain tightness, relying instead on Spring reverb and EQ shaping for that bright reggae chime.

rig.name: Jimmy Cliff - The harder they come - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Clean up ambient noise and maintain tight rhythm definition.
Provide initial lift and clarity for the percussive stabs.
blocks.gap: A dedicated clean boost (like an Octave or Clean Boost) would be ideal, but 'Boost' serves to tighten the signal.

blocks.purpose: Keep the tone clean and non-distorted for reggae rhythm.
Simulate the bright, clean, and articulate tone of a Vox AC30 style amp.
blocks.gap: The US Deluxe is the closest available model to achieve a classic British chime/clean sound without using specific tube models (like UK 45).

blocks.purpose: Provide a bright, focused sound suitable for reggae and ska rhythms.
blocks.gap: A 1x12 or specific vintage British cab would be better, but the US 2x12 provides necessary brightness and focus.

blocks.purpose: Enhance the upper mids and treble for that characteristic bright reggae chime.
Keep the tone static and focused on rhythm stabs.
Avoid chorus as per the musical verdict to maintain tightness.
Keep the delay minimal or off to maintain a dry, percussive feel.
Add the required slight springy reverb for depth without losing percussive attack.
Control overall output level for optimal mix balance.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR to a vintage British cab simulation (1x12 or 2x12) for authentic reggae/ska chime.

proposals.reason: US 2x12 lacks the specific vintage British voicing needed for reggae/ska chime.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased authenticity and clarity in upper mids.
